items.name: Christmas Cubing Sigua 2023
items.information:
Christmas Cubing Sigua 2023 es una competencia que se realizara a 30 minutos de la capital colonial de Honduras, siendo apoyada por la alcaldia municipal de Siguatepeque. Sera un evento abierto a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad.

__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Christmas Cubing Sigua 2023 is a competition that will take place 30 minutes from the colonial capital of Honduras, being supported by the municipal mayor of Siguatepeque. It will be an event open to competitors of any nationality.

items.name: Indian Nationals FMC 2023
items.information:
**YOU MUST INCLUDE THE LOCATION YOU ARE ATTENDING IN YOUR REGISTRATION COMMENT.**

The competition will be held in multiple locations across India, and there is a separate fee for each city. For more information, refer to [locations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianNationalsFMC2023#35621-locations) tab.

The winner of FMC will be crowned the FMC National Champion, and prizes will be awarded at the [Indian Nationals 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianNationals2023/) prize ceremony.

items.name: Keep Austin Weird 2023
items.information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KeepAustinWeird2023#35928-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KeepAustinWeird2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 
	
To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).

items.name: Carolina Clock 'Stravaganza 2023

venue.name: Movement Family Martial Arts
venue.address: 598 Indian Trail Rd South, Indian Trail, North Carolina USA

items.information:
**Please note this is not a normal competition. There is no standard 3x3x3 Cube event.**

Registration includes a shirt. Please put your shirt size in the comment section of your registration.
Please always include your **name** and competition name in any email that you send to us.
All competitors must read the "Competitor Information" tab prior to registering.
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

Only **one** guest per competitor will be allowed.

The main event is Clock. Clock Finals will be held Head-to-Head (time permitting)

This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/).

items.name: Beckman Gets Big 2023
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BeckmanGetsBig2023#32924-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

**Please do not bring any cigarettes, alcoholic beverages, or pets into the venue.**

**NO FLASH PHOTOGRAPHY ALLOWED**
